name: viewer-data
commands: mkdir -p /kaggle/temp/sweep && for f in {PREV}/dd3d-intervene-sweep/*.tar; do tar xf $f -C /kaggle/temp/sweep; done
mkdir -p /kaggle/temp/patch && for f in {PREV}/dd3d-intervene-patch/*.tar; do tar xf $f -C /kaggle/temp/patch; done

python scripts/experiments/sweep_package.py --outputs /kaggle/temp/sweep/sweep_b04 --plan {PREV}/dd3d-analyze-sweep-plans/out/sweep/sweep_b04/plan.npz --splits {DATA}/v2/splits --images {DATA}/v2/images --note 'SANA-1.6B, blok 4, wzorzec z cech t = 400' --out {OUT}/viewer/sweep_b04.json

python scripts/experiments/sweep_package.py --outputs /kaggle/temp/sweep/sweep_b10 --plan {PREV}/dd3d-analyze-sweep-plans/out/sweep/sweep_b10/plan.npz --splits {DATA}/v2/splits --images {DATA}/v2/images --note 'SANA-1.6B, blok 10, wzorzec z cech t = 400' --out {OUT}/viewer/sweep_b10.json

python scripts/experiments/sweep_package.py --outputs /kaggle/temp/patch/patch_part0 --plan {PREV}/dd3d-plans/plan_patch_part0.dat --splits {DATA}/v2/splits --images {DATA}/v2/images --source-images {DATA}/v2rot/images --max-images 8 --note 'SANA-1.6B, przeszczep tokenów z renderu ze światłem +90 stopni' --out {OUT}/viewer/patch.json
